extract_bert_layers_for_distillation: extract selected BERT encoder layers into a compressed checkpoint for DistilBERT distillation
run_distillation_checkpoint_extraction: run the script to extract BERT weights and save a distilled model checkpoint
build_distilbert_transfer_checkpoint: build a transfer learning checkpoint by mapping BERT layers to DistilBERT architecture
test_extract_with_vocab_transform: test the extraction script with vocab_transform flag to include prediction transform weights
summarize_extracted_parameters: summarize the number of layers selected and parameters transferred for distillation
